profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer and Software Projects Technical Lead, Optivus Proton Therapy
profile.summary: Experienced Principal Software Engineer with a demonstrated history and robust experience spanning nearly two decades in the medical device industry with hardware and software products possessing FDA 510(k) clearance. Strong engineering professional skilled in C++, Python, Visual Studio, Windows and Linux operating systems, and authoring detailed technical documentation, with a passion for software- and hardware-based high-performance computing solutions.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.locationName: San Bernardino County, California, United States
positions.description:
I complete research, development, design, testing, analysis, & maintenance of Optivus Proton Therapy software applications & control systems (Conforma 3000 Proton Beam Treatment System; Odyssey treatment planning system) which possess FDA 510(k), ISO 13485 & 14971 compliance with >30 years of patient treatment history.

Work performed coincides with hardware development & requires task planning & estimating skills. I apply intensive & comprehensive knowledge of engineering & scientific principles to complete projects. I evaluate new technology for applicability into company product development. I make decisions independently on problems & methods. I represent the company abroad to resolve important issues and to plan and coordinate work.

Overview of duties and responsibilities:

•Complete complex projects requiring development of new or highly modified engineering/scientific techniques & procedures; demonstrates extensive knowledge of specialty.
•Ensure technical specifications address client & company needs with the minimal amount of acceptable risk.
•Interpret & evaluates results to determine their validity & scientific significance.
•Work results in the development of new or refined products, process, equipment, or scientific methods that may result in patent or publication.
•Resolve complex problems that involve design or implementation optimization or innovative techniques.
•Provide technical guidance to lower level engineers.
•As Team Lead:  plan, organize, & direct large & important software engineering projects, or several small projects with many complex features.
•Provide assistance to Computer Science Specialization Team Leader to define scope & critical elements of projects & selecting approaches to be taken.
•Provide visionary plans for future growth of company products within specialty.
•Participate in creation of company products outside software development specialization responsibilities.
•Provide ongoing software integration & testing support.

positions.title: Technical Lead
positions.description: In this role, I am defining and developing high-level interfaces between oncology software systems, defining data export, and coordinating software system interoperability, compliance, and compatibility between multiple oncology software vendors. As a logical continuation of that effort, I am also coordinating the design and development of the software ecosystem that consists of software modules being developed by my software team to complete the objectives of our current software projects. A key responsibility in this position is to create a "big picture" (concept) of top-level software architecture for each software system (both ours and from other vendors), and guide our engineers to identify technical risks and overcome them. I also assist Executive Team members in development and coordination of dataflow between software and other disciplines (Electrical Engineering, IT, Manufacturing), as well as provide technical coordination between the Executive Team and medical device vendors whose software systems are being integrated with ours.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
My typical responsibilities involve performing work in research, development, design, testing, risk and hazard analysis, production, and maintenance of the Optivus Proton Therapy software systems (Conforma 3000 Proton Beam Treatment System; Odyssey radiation treatment planning system) used at Loma Linda University Medical Center. Conforma 3000 and Odyssey possess FDA 510(k) clearance, maintain ISO 13485 and ISO 14971 compliance, and have been treating patients for over 25 years.

My essential duties and responsibilities as a Senior Software Engineer include the following:

--Complete complex projects requiring development of new or highly modified engineering or scientific techniques and procedures, with extensive knowledge of specialty.
--Interprets and evaluates results to determine their validity and scientific significance.
--As a team leader:  plan, organize, or direct large software engineering projects, or a number of small projects with many complex features.
--Assist engineering team leaders and Vice President of Engineering to define scope and critical elements of projects and selecting approaches to be taken.
--Complete engineering tasks in coordination with other engineering and technology disciplines:  mechanical, electrical, systems, and manufacturing engineering; information technology; computer systems administration.
--Coordinate with software and engineering team members to provide 24-hour on-call technical support for Conforma 3000 hardware and software systems at Loma Linda University Medical Center, to ensure at least 99 percent system uptime.
--Provide software integration and testing support as appropriate.
--Port Linux software and drivers for proton treatment system hardware components originally developed on legacy hardware to function properly on modern x86-based systems.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
My essential duties and responsibilities as a Software Engineer included the following for the Odyssey radiation treatment planning system:

--Create software development plans.
--Create software requirements specifications.
--Create hazard analysis and failure modes & effects analysis documentation.
--Create software architectural and detailed design documentation of fairly limited scope and complexity.
--Implement software system designs.
--Create system integration and module testing documentation.
--Participate in the creation of company products working outside software development specialization responsibilities.
--Provide software integration and testing support as appropriate.

In addition to these software engineering tasks, I also performed the following:

--Moderate team meetings.
--Provide IT support to our engineering teams.
--Provide customer and end-user support.

positions.title: Computer Support Specialist
positions.description:
While completing my undergraduate and graduate degrees in Computer Science, I served as a part-time student assistant for the CSUSB Pfau Library Automation Services Help Desk with the following responsibilities:

--Provide on-call end-user support for all faculty and staff at the Library Automation Services Help Desk.
--Troubleshoot and resolve software and hardware problems reported by Library faculty and staff.
--Perform software and hardware upgrades for Library computer systems.
--Maintain Library public computer workstations for student use.
--Assist Automation Services system administrators with hardware and software support requests.

volunteerExperiences.description:
My volunteer tasks vary throughout the year, but typically include the following:

--Setup and takedown of gym equipment before and after hosting league meets at Flips Gymnastics facilities.
--Cook food at the grill for the snack bar, to help Flips Gymnastics raise money for covering hosting fees for league meets.
--Clean-up before and after hosting league meets at Flips Gymnastics facilities (clean bathrooms; take out trash; clean floors).
--Perform computer support services on an as-needed basis (Point of Sale (POS) computers; personal computers used during Flips Gymnastics hosted events).

--Perform nightly cleaning duties after weekday classes.
--Assist with coordination of junior instructor responsibilities and scheduling.
--Assist with completion of school interior renovation tasks.
